jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Azure
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Design and implement BI-oriented data models using Kimball and Snowflake methodologies based on business requirements.
• Develop fact tables, dimensions, and aggregates within the data warehouse environment.
• Design and develop ETL flows in Microsoft Fabric using Dataflows Gen2, PySpark Notebooks, and Pipelines.
• Ensure the quality, reliability, monitoring, and performance of all data flows and features.
• Automate deployment processes using CI/CD pipelines through Azure DevOps or GitHub.
• Connect to and optimize extractions from diverse sources such as Oracle, SQL Server, and flat files.
• Document all technical operations and data flows to ensure traceability and maintainability.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
• You bring 3+ years of experience working with Microsoft Fabric on Azure Cloud.
• You possess expert knowledge of Kimball methodology, including Star Schema, Snowflake, and SCD.
• You're advanced in SQL with proven experience managing Oracle and SQL Server databases.
• You have extensive experience using PySpark for processing large data volumes.
• You bring proven proficiency in creating semantic models for Power BI.
• You possess technical expertise in ETL/ELT processes, specifically with Dataflows Gen2 and Pipelines.
• You're familiar with automating implementations using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
• You have a collaborative mindset and respect for technical standards and internal procedures.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with passive knowledge of the other language and active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Azure Synapse or Azure Data Lake.
• Familiarity with DAX.
• Knowledge of Sparx Enterprise Architect for system documentation.
• Willingness to learn Informatica PowerCenter.

Our client is looking for an ICT Operations & Support to support end users and IT operations across several international locations. This position combines hands-on technical support, workplace technologies management, and coordination with global IT teams to ensure a seamless user experience and reliable IT services. It's a temporary contract with the possibility of a permanent position.

• Provide first and second-line support for workplace technologies, end-user devices, and business applications.
• Act as the primary IT contact for multiple international locations, ensuring effective user support and service continuity.
• Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and collaboration tool issues.
• Coordinate with central service desk and infrastructure teams to manage incidents and escalations.
• Support the diagnosis of networking and telephony-related issues.
• Contribute to international IT projects, technology deployments, and infrastructure initiatives.
• Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset inventories, and ensure compliance with security standards and procedures.

Profile

• 3 to 5 years of experience in ICT Operations, Digital Workplace, End-User Computing, or IT Support environments.
• Strong knowledge of: Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint), Microsoft Copilot
• Good understanding of networking fundamentals:
• Experience working within IT service management environments and centralized support structures.
• English: professional proficiency required ; any other language is a plus

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …),
 

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.
 

As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for 
Repair Operators/Body Shop Painters to strengthen our teams.
 

As a 
Repair Operator/Body Shop Painter, you carry out various tasks related to repairs and adjustments on aircraft engine parts
 
 

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures); 

• You perform the assigned tasks accurately and respect the planning in order to avoid any negative impact on work organization, scheduling, or complaints from internal customers. 

• You will use the required PPE when performing tasks according to the rules defined by HSE or the usual regulations within SAESB (e.g., risk analysis); 

• You report clearly and precisely on identified issues, difficulties, or risks related to the activity or the product, using the designated reporting tools; 

• You communicate the status of the activity/activities at the end of the shift; 

• You will participate in working groups to analyze problems and improve work processes (continuous improvement, error and defect analysis and correction, internal and external audits, etc.). 

Your profile:

• You hold a secondary education diploma in a technical field.
• You have a good knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6am - 2pm or 2pm - 10pm).
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment, and are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Your tasks include:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

•   Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies

  3) Stakeholder Management 
   
•   Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience    
•   Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.    
•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit

  COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

•   Ability to prioritize, quickly synthesize information and apply regulatory requirements to a variety of scenarios    
•   Must exercise excellent judgement, make decisions based on a clear understanding of the regulatory framework, deploying strategies to conduct compliant business    
•   Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?

• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Forklift certification required.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:

• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.
• Risk analysis.
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.
• Commitment and practical approach to work.
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.
• Curiosity and passion for technology.
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.
• Teamwork and communication skills.

Account Management & Business Development

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:

• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:

• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge
• You speak good English.

?? Where’s all this happening?

At a company based at Arcelor Mittal (Ghent/Zelzate) – not just any place!They’re experts in packing machines, installations, steel, and more. If it needs wrapping, these folks do it better than bubble wrap.

Jobomschrijving

Looking for a job where your muscles will finally have something to do – and steel will tremble at the sight of you? We’ve got just the thing for you!

Our client is on the hunt for a new team member – a packer with personality, humor, and the guts to face the mighty steel rolls in a three-shift battle. If you're not afraid of a challenge, love to stay active, and see “team” as more than just a word – then you’re exactly who they’re looking for!

Ready to roll?

Click, apply, and pack your future with us – strong, stable, and well-paid.

Who are we looking for?

Maybe you, if:

• You’re in shape – no need to be The Rock, but lifting steel rolls does require more than just clicking a mouse ??,
• Shifts? Three? You’re in – no whining, no problem,
• You take safety seriously (a forklift is not a race car ?),
• Small talk is your superpower – you feel like a fish in water speaking Dutch or English.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving
